text:
Maya Patel: Hey team — getting Fluxora case study interview transcribed. Need: pull a customer quote we can use in launch post + confirm legal ok on any product claims. Planning a short webinar to surface the benchmark results next quarter. Who can take ownership of quote clearance?

Benji Kim: I can do quote vetting. Will pull the raw transcript and mark anything risky. link: https://drive.redwood.com/fluxora/interview_transcript

Chris O'Leary: +1. Also can we reserve a webinar slot week of May 11? prefer Tue/Thu mornings. I'll ping events.

Sophia Ruiz: I can draft the launch post once quote's cleared. Quick ask — can we get a 1-2 sentence "before/after" benchmark blurb from the product team? e.g., "Fluxora reduced inference cost by 37% at 99th pct latency" — we'll need numbers verified.

Maya Patel: here's a raw customer quote to consider:
"Fluxora's pipelines saw a 3x throughput boost and our infra spend dropped dramatically — it finally made LLM features viable for us."

Benji Kim: Log of redlines I'm proposing:
- remove "3x" if not backed by A/B benchmark (replace with 'significant')
- change "dramatically" -> 'meaningfully'
- ask for metric source & date

Chris O'Leary: Events confirmed tentative Thu May 13 10am PT. Will finalize after we lock the webinar narrative.

Legal Review Bot: Ticket #LR-482 created. Assigned to @Sophia Ruiz for initial review. Please attach the final quote and any benchmark docs.

Sophia Ruiz: Attaching draft post and proposed quote variants (quick):
> "With Redwood, Fluxora increased throughput by 200% while cutting per-token cost by 37%."

Maya Patel: @Benji Kim can you confirm metrics by EOD Friday? Legal needs the final quote to clear embargo. Also need headshot + 1-sentence bio from Fluxora.

Benji Kim: Will confirm metrics & source. If product can't validate exact percent, we'll use 'about one-third' language and note benchmark date.

Sophia Ruiz: Thanks — prepping webinar narrative + slides. Will drop a link to the slide deck once Benji confirms.

Maya Patel: Awesome. Next steps: Benji validates metrics; Legal clears final quote; Sophia finalizes post + slides; Chris books webinar page and flow. Ping me if blockers.

Chris O'Leary: Adding a quick checklist for launch ops:
- final quote (legal-approved)
- slide deck + screenshots
- registration page & email copy
- press/media list
- embargo timing

Benji Kim: Starting metric check now. Will update thread when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
